skill.name: meeting-notes
skill.description: Creates structured meeting notes that capture agendas, discussion points, decisions, action items, next steps, and parking lot topics.
skill.summary: Create clear meeting minutes with decisions, action items, next steps, and parking lot items.
skill.author: shubhamsaboo

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are false positives caused by markdown formatting and ordinary meeting note guidance. I found no prompt injection, malicious intent, data exfiltration, or unsafe command behavior in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 28 starts a fenced markdown template, not shell or Ruby backtick execution. The block only shows the desired meeting note structure and contains no executable command.
Line 73 says to focus on outcomes, not process, as a note-taking style rule. It contains no network scanning, reconnaissance instructions, or external access behavior.

content.value_statement: Meeting notes often lose decisions, owners, and deadlines after a discussion ends. This skill turns rough notes into clear minutes with action items, decisions, and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Formats rough notes into a standard meeting minutes structure.
Captures agenda topics and key discussion points.
Lists decisions made during the meeting.
Creates action items with owners, deadlines, and status fields.
Separates next steps from parking lot topics.
Supports concise notes for team syncs and recurring meetings.
limitations: Does not transcribe audio or video by itself.
Requires meeting context, rough notes, or a transcript as input.
Does not verify attendee names, decisions, or deadlines independently.
Does not manage calendars or send follow-up messages.

use_cases.title: Document Product Planning
use_cases.description: Turn planning discussions into decisions, owners, deadlines, and launch follow-up tasks.

use_cases.title: Capture Engineering Reviews
use_cases.description: Summarize technical discussions with blockers, decisions, owners, and next review dates.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Syncs
use_cases.description: Create consistent minutes for recurring meetings and track follow-up work.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize Basic Notes
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these rough notes into meeting notes with attendees, agenda, key points, decisions, action items, and next steps: [paste notes]

prompt_templates.title: Extract Action Items
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these meeting notes and create a clear action item table with owner, deadline, status, and related decision: [paste notes]

prompt_templates.title: Create Executive Minutes
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this transcript into concise executive minutes. Highlight strategic decisions, unresolved issues, risks, owners, deadlines, and follow-up meetings: [paste transcript]

prompt_templates.title: Standardize Recurring Meetings
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced template design for repeated meetings.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a reusable minutes format for this recurring meeting. Include agenda sections, decision log, action tracker, parking lot, and follow-up rules: [meeting context]

output_examples.input: Rough product sync notes about launch timeline, budget approval, and documentation owners.
output: Meeting title and date placeholders are organized at the top.
Decisions list confirms launch date and approved budget.
Action items assign documentation, quality review, and customer communication owners.

output_examples.input: Weekly engineering standup notes with blockers, completed work, and next review date.
output: Key discussion points group blockers by project area.
Next steps list owner, deadline, and current status.
Parking lot captures topics that need separate technical review.

output_examples.input: Leadership meeting transcript covering quarterly priorities and hiring needs.
output: Summary highlights priority changes and approved hiring actions.
Decision section separates confirmed commitments from open questions.
Follow-up section records owners for budget review and recruiting updates.

best_practices: Provide attendee names, dates, and raw discussion context when available.
Ask for owners and deadlines when action items are missing.
Review sensitive notes before sharing them outside the meeting group.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the skill to invent decisions that were not discussed.
Do not use vague owners such as team or everyone for action items.
Do not paste confidential transcripts into tools without approved data handling.

faq.question: Can this skill summarize a transcript?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the transcript or rough notes, and it will organize the content into meeting minutes.

faq.question: Does it create action items?
faq.answer: Yes. It formats action items with task descriptions, owners, deadlines, and status fields.

faq.question: Can it identify decisions?
faq.answer: Yes. It separates decisions from discussion points when the source notes include enough context.

faq.question: Does it transcribe audio?
faq.answer: No. It works with text that you provide, such as notes or a transcript.

faq.question: Can it support recurring meetings?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply the same note structure across team syncs and recurring reviews.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: It supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
